value.rationale: A complete all-screening optimum and sharp single transition over the entire natural walk-regular cone class, including non-vertex-transitive bases. The theorem proves that strictly larger peripheral Green diagonals can identify the wrong optimal rank-one column and supplies a nontrivial finite-size threshold correction for wheel cones; generic known sketch identities alone do not supply this design law.
